<div  class="is-promoted l-full">
    <div class="l-full__header">
        
<div  class="c-page-title">
	<div class="c-page-title__inner l-constrain">
		<div class="c-page-title__row">
			<div>
				<div class="c-page-title__content">
											<div class="c-page-title__meta">ICS Advisory</div>
										<h1 class="c-page-title__title">
<span>Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLCs Web Server</span>
</h1>
																																				<div class="c-page-title__fields">  




<div  class="c-field c-field--name-field-release-date c-field--type-datetime c-field--label-above">
  <div  class="c-field__label">Release Date</div><div class="c-field__content"><time datetime="2026-10-22T12:00:00Z">October 22, 2026</time></div></div>

  




<div  class="c-field c-field--name-field-alert-code c-field--type-string c-field--label-above">
  <div  class="c-field__label">Alert Code</div><div class="c-field__content">ICSA-26-295-14</div></div>

</div>
																										<div class="c-page-title__topic">
							<div class="c-topic__label">
								Related topics:
							</div>
							<div class="c-top__topics">
																																												<a href="/topics/industrial-control-systems/industrial-control-system-vulnerabilities">Industrial Control System Vulnerabilities</a>
										,
																																																							<a href="/topics/industrial-control-systems">Industrial Control Systems</a>
																																		</div>
						</div>
									</div>
				<div class="c-page-title__decoration"></div>
			</div>
					</div>
	</div>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="l-full__main">
                      

<div  class="l-page-section l-page-section--rich-text csaf-imported">
      <div class="l-constrain">
  
  
  <div class="l-page-section__content">
          <p><a href="https://github.com/cisagov/CSAF/blob/develop/csaf_files/OT/white/2026/icsa-26-295-14.json"><strong>View CSAF</strong></a></p>
<h2>Summary</h2>
<p><strong>SIMATIC S7-1500 devices contain multiple vulnerabilities in the web server that could allow an attacker to execute malicious code in an authorized user’s browser session and perform PLC operations within the scope of that user’s authorization. Siemens is preparing fixes and recommends specific mitigations for products where fixes are not or not yet available.</strong></p>
<p>The following versions of Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLCs Web Server are affected:</p>
<ul>
<li>SIMATIC Drive Controller CPU 1504D TF (6ES7615-4DF10-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC Drive Controller CPU 1507D TF (6ES7615-7DF10-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1510SP F-1 PN (6ES7510-1SJ01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1510SP F-1 PN (6ES7510-1SK03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1510SP-1 PN (6ES7510-1DJ01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1510SP-1 PN (6ES7510-1DK03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1512SP F-1 PN (6ES7512-1SK01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1512SP F-1 PN (6ES7512-1SM03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1512SP-1 PN (6ES7512-1DK01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1512SP-1 PN (6ES7512-1DM03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1514SP F-2 PN (6ES7514-2SN03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1514SP-2 PN (6ES7514-2DN03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1514SPT F-2 PN (6ES7514-2WN03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP CPU 1514SPT-2 PN (6ES7514-2VN03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP Open Controller CPU 1515SP PC (incl. SIPLUS variants) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP Open Controller CPU 1515SP PC2 (incl. SIPLUS variants) V2 CPUs - Windows OS vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP Open Controller CPU 1515SP PC2 (incl. SIPLUS variants) V3 CPUs - Industrial OS vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP Open Controller CPU 1515SP PC2 (incl. SIPLUS variants) V3 CPUs - Windows OS vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC ET 200SP Open Controller CPU 1515SP PC3 V4 CPUs vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511-1 PN (6ES7511-1AK00-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511-1 PN (6ES7511-1AK01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511-1 PN (6ES7511-1AK02-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511-1 PN (6ES7511-1AL03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511C-1 PN (6ES7511-1CK00-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511C-1 PN (6ES7511-1CK01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511C-1 PN (6ES7511-1CL03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511F-1 PN (6ES7511-1FK01-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511F-1 PN (6ES7511-1FK02-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>
<li>SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1511F-1 PN (6ES7511-1FL03-0AB0) vers:all/* (CVE-2026-63350, CVE-2026-63351, CVE-2026-63352, CVE-2026-63353, CVE-2026-63354, CVE-2026-63355, CVE-2026-63356, CVE-2026-63357)</li>

<h2>Vulnerabilities</h2>
<div class="icsa-etb-toggle-wrapper"><a class="icsa-etb-toggle-all" href="#">Expand All +</a></div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63350</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly restrict executable content contained in imported trace files. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton-wrapper"><a class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton" href="#">Read More</a></div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body2">
<h4>157 Affected Products</h4>
<hr>
<h5>SIMATIC Drive Controller CPU 1504D TF (6ES7615-4DF10-0AB0)</h5>
<div>
<p>Product Status: known_affected</p>
</div>
<h6>Remediations</h6>
<div>
<p><strong>Mitigation</strong><br>Disable the webserver if not required on the affected systems. Restrict the access to Port 80/tcp and 443/tcp to trusted IP address only</p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>Mitigation</strong><br>Ensure only qualified personnel is authorized to access the web server</p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>Mitigation</strong><br>Only upload trusted trace files</p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>None available</strong><br>Currently no fix is available</p>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63351</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual properties of calculated signals contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering them on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton-wrapper"><a class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton" href="#">Read More</a></div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63352</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal data contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton-wrapper"><a class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton" href="#">Read More</a></div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63353</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly sanitize comment fields contained in imported trace files before rendering them on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63354</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual marker data contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton-wrapper"><a class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton" href="#">Read More</a></div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63355</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly sanitize signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering them in selection menus on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Attacker-controlled JavaScript could be executed in the user’s browser session when the user subsequently interacts with an affected selection menu.</div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63356</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before including them in error messages on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Attacker-controlled JavaScript could be executed in the user’s browser session when the resulting error message is displayed.</div>

<div class="c-expandable-textbox icsa-etb">
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__title">CVE-2026-63357</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox__body">Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal data contained in imported calculated signal files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.</div>
<div class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton-wrapper"><a class="c-expandable-textbox-morebutton" href="#">Read More</a></div>

<h2>Acknowledgments</h2>
<ul>

<hr>
<h2>General Recommendations</h2>
<p>As a general security measure, Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to devices with appropriate mechanisms. In order to operate the devices in a protected IT environment, Siemens recommends to configure the environment according to Siemens' operational guidelines for Industrial Security (Download: https://www.siemens.com/cert/operational-guidelines-industrial-security), and to follow the recommendations in the product manuals. Additional information on Industrial Security by Siemens can be found at: https://www.siemens.com/industrialsecurity</p>
<hr>
<h2>Additional Resources</h2>
<p>For further inquiries on security vulnerabilities in Siemens products and solutions, please contact the Siemens ProductCERT: https://www.siemens.com/cert/advisories</p>
<hr>
<h2>Terms of Use</h2>
<p>The use of Siemens Security Advisories is subject to the terms and conditions listed on: https://www.siemens.com/productcert/terms-of-use.</p>
<hr>
<h2>Recommended Practices</h2>
<p>CISA recommends users take defensive measures to minimize the risk of exploitation of these vulnerabilities.</p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Minimize network exposure for all control system devices and/or systems, ensuring they are <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/uscert/ics/alerts/ICS-ALERT-10-301-01">not accessible from the internet</a>.</li>
<li>Locate control system networks and remote devices behind firewalls and isolating them from business networks.</li>
<li>When remote access is required, use more secure methods, such as Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), recognizing VPNs may have vulnerabilities and should be updated to the most current version available. Also recognize VPN is only as secure as the connected devices.</li>
</ul>
<p>CISA reminds organizations to perform proper impact analysis and risk assessment prior to deploying defensive measures.</p>
<p>CISA also provides a section for <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/ics-recommended-practices">control systems security recommended practices</a> on the ICS webpage on <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/topics/industrial-control-systems">cisa.gov/ics</a>. Several CISA products detailing cyber defense best practices are available for reading and download, including <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/recommended_practices/NCCIC_ICS-CERT_Defense_in_Depth_2016_S508C.pdf">Improving Industrial Control Systems Cybersecurity with Defense-in-Depth Strategies</a>.</p>
<p>CISA encourages organizations to implement recommended cybersecurity strategies for <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/publications/Cybersecurity_Best_Practices_for_Industrial_Control_Systems.pdf">proactive defense of ICS assets</a>.</p>
<p>Additional mitigation guidance and recommended practices are publicly available on the ICS webpage at <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/topics/industrial-control-systems">cisa.gov/ics</a> in the technical information paper, <a href="https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news/targeted-cyber-intrusion-detection-and-mitigation-strategies-update-b">ICS-TIP-12-146-01B--Targeted Cyber Intrusion Detection and Mitigation Strategies</a>.</p>
<p>Organizations observing suspected malicious activity should follow established internal procedures and report findings to CISA for tracking and correlation against other incidents.</p>
<hr>
